'''Jason Alan Behrstock''' is a mathematician at the [[City University of New York]] known for his work in [[geometric group theory]] and [[low-dimensional topology]].<ref name=homepage>{{cite web|title=Jason Behrstock|url=http://comet.lehman.cuny.edu/behrstock/|accessdate=Feb 6, 2015}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Behrstock was born in California and was educated in California's public school system.<ref name=meridian>{{cite news|newspaper=The Meridian|url=http://www.lcmeridian.com/2010/04/01/professor-jason-behrstock-wins-alfred-p-sloan-research-fellowship/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150206205525/http://www.lcmeridian.com/2010/04/01/professor-jason-behrstock-wins-alfred-p-sloan-research-fellowship/|url-status=usurped|archive-date=February 6, 2015|title=PROFESSOR JASON BEHRSTOCK WINS ALFRED P. SLOAN RESEARCH FELLOWSHIP|date=Apr 1, 2010|accessdate=Feb 6, 2015}}</ref> He received his Ph.D. from [[State University of New York at Stony Brook]] in 2004.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=86328|title=Jason Alan Behrstock}}</ref> He went to work at [[Columbia University]] and the [[University of Utah]] before his time at [[Lehman College]], [[City University of New York]].<ref name=today/>

==Awards and honors==
*In 2009, Behrstock was award the [[Feliks Gross]] Endowment Award by the [[Graduate Center of the City University of New York]], a research award for young faculty.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://wp.lehman.edu/lehman-today/2012/05/lehman-economics-professor-wins-feliks-gross-award/|date=May 3, 2012|location=Lehman College, City University of New York|title=Lehman Economics Professor Wins Feliks Gross Award|newspaper=Lehman Today|accessdate=Feb 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150206202429/http://wp.lehman.edu/lehman-today/2012/05/lehman-economics-professor-wins-feliks-gross-award/|archive-date=February 6, 2015|url-status=dead}} The article is about another recipient, but mentions Behrstock.</ref>
*In 2010, Behrstock was awarded the [[Alfred P. Sloan Fellowship]].<ref name=today>{{cite news|title=Prestigious Alfred P. Sloan Research Fellowship Awarded to Lehman Mathematics Professor Jason Behrstock|newspaper=Lehman Today|location=Lehman College, City University of New York|date=Mar 1, 2010|accessdate=Feb 6, 2015|url=http://www.lehman.cuny.edu/lehmantoday/2010_03/t_behrstock.html|archive-date=February 6, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150206211215/http://www.lehman.cuny.edu/lehmantoday/2010_03/t_behrstock.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*In 2012, Behrstock became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2015-02-06 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref>
*Behrstock became a [[Simons Foundation|Simons Fellow]] in 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|title=Simons Fellows Awardees: Mathematics|accessdate=Feb 6, 2015|archive-date=December 26, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141226005932/https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*Behrstock, Jason A. "Asymptotic geometry of the mapping class group and Teichmüller space". ''Geom. Topol.'' 10 (2006), pages 1523–1578.
*Behrstock, Jason; Druţu, Cornelia; Mosher, Lee. "Thick metric spaces, relative hyperbolicity, and quasi-isometric rigidity". ''Math. Ann.'' 344 (2009), number 3, pages 543–595.
*Behrstock, Jason A.; Minsky, Yair N. "Dimension and rank for mapping class groups". ''Ann. of Math.'' (2) 167 (2008), number 3, pages 1055–1077.
